say:0:1510671001:1.text: Piles of wooden parts are heaped on the ground—some less decayed than others, and you can still vaguely make out their original shape.
say:0:1510671001:1.source_cn: 地上堆积着许多木质零件。其中一些腐烂程度较浅，依稀还可...

say:1:1510671002:1.text: Looking at the material, texture, and craftsmanship, they're a perfect match for the parts on Sedecim. No doubt, these were used for making puppets.
say:1:1510671002:1.source_cn: 无论是从材质、纹理、做工，哪个方面来看，它们都和十六身...
